description: Direct and produce a short film made entirely in code, in one of the styles of the Lemo-Opuscar library (e.g. Impasto Oil Painting 油画厚涂, Watercolor Brush 水彩笔刷, Ukiyo-e 浮世绘, Satellite Briefing 卫星简报, Exploded Teardown 产品拆解, Microscope Story 显微叙事). Use when the user asks for a video, film, short, promo, explainer or animation (视频、短片、动画、宣传片) in a named style, including data, science and product explainers built from real material such as satellite imagery, laser scans, CAD files or archive scans (数据解说、科普、产品拆解); when they want a film made about their own topic and haven't chosen a style (help them choose); when they want to change a style and keep it as their own (改风格、做自己的风格); or when they ask which film styles there are. Not for editing or converting existing video files.
